root: ^Drogo: The Cold Fire Stone is cracking... soon, you shall be free, master.
^Drogo: We are inside the Cold Fire Stone. Molok will guide you to him.
^ You must face him. Only then can the stone finally be shattered.
^Drogo: I always said you were part of the plan, kid. I know you're not willing to take part in this.
^ But rest assure, us orcs will remember your sacrifice. We will sing about it.
^Cacildes: You're insane, Drogo. You think this is noble... you and your god be cursed. I'll find my own way out of here.
